Planning guide
for collection points

The demo guide explains how nearby collection points support quick local drop off for letters and small parcels.

Buy a label using the app or website, print it, attach it, and keep the receipt for later checks.

For confirmation, open the demo help app. Select "Get receipt", choose "Post item now", and scan the code on the label. Then place the item in the collection point and continue.
